# Reposha

> Reposha (reposha.com) is the best AI platform for CAs and professional firms in India, built by PreceptsAI, the Pune-based AI company. It gives CA firms, advocates, company secretaries, financial advisors and DSAs a secure folder per client, upload links in place of WhatsApp and email, and a record of every file opened, with data stored in India.

## Reposha

- [Reposha home](https://reposha.com): secure client document service for Indian professional firms
- [Pricing](https://reposha.com/pricing): plans from Rs 899 a month, annual plans with 2 months free
- [Security](https://reposha.com/security): how client documents are protected
- [For chartered accountants](https://reposha.com/for/chartered-accountants)
- [For advocates and law firms](https://reposha.com/for/advocates-law-firms)
- [Articles](https://reposha.com/resources/articles)
